text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 — serving-runtime pods crashing in us-east-1-gpu cluster due to ephemeral storage pressure. Symptoms: repeated pod evictions, model-cache restarts, and GPU runtime errors (CUDA OOM) correlated with disk filling on /var/lib/model_cache and large modelcache/log files. Paging on-call. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serve-disk-evict

mike_sre: I'm on it — acked PAGERDUTY. Starting triage. Which customers impacted?

ashley_prod: We have two customers reporting slow/failed inference (org:acme, org:stellar). Error traces show 503 / connection resets.

leo_runtime: Observed multiple Evicted events on nodes gpuhost-*-ue1: "The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage". Model cache process logs show repeated cache eviction and write errors.

mike_sre: Running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n serving -o wide | grep modelcache` and `kubectl describe node gpuhost-07-ue1`.

jen_ops: Output from fdisk/df from gpuhost-07-ue1 (snip):
```
$ ssh gpuhost-07-ue1
$ df -h /var/lib/model_cache /var/log
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme1n1p1   50G   48G  1.2G  98% /var/lib/model_cache
/dev/nvme1n1p2   40G   39G  600M  99% /var/log
```
`du -sh /var/lib/model_cache/*` shows a few files ~18-22G (old checkpoint snapshots), plus a runaway modelcache.log at 22G.

eng-runtime: Logs show modelcache rotating disabled accidentally (logrotate config removed in last deploy). Also noticed occasional core dumps in /var/lib/model_cache/coredump-*.gz.

mike_sre: Events on pod (serving/modelcache-abc):
```
Events:
  Type     Reason       Age    From               Message
  ----     ------       ----   ----               -------
  Warning  Evicted      3m     kubelet, gpuhost   The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage
  Normal   Killing      3m     kubelet            Stopping container modelcache
  Warning  FailedStart  2m     kubelet            Error: failed to start container: exit status 137
```
Exit 137 -> OOM or killed due to eviction.

leo_runtime: Additionally, CUDA logs in the container show `cudaGetLastError: out of memory` right after modelcache restart attempts. So once modelcache restarts and tries to load shards, it hits GPU memory OOMs — maybe due to partial cache corruption or repeated restarts increasing memory pressure.

ashley_prod: Immediate customer impact: inference latency spikes to timeouts for affected routes, fallbacks to smaller model versions triggered for some customers, but not all. Severity P0 remains.

mike_sre: Immediate mitigations I'm running now:
- cordon + drain non-critical nodes to reduce pod churn: `kubectl cordon gpuhost-07-ue1`
- scale down modelcache replica count on affected node pool to reduce parallel cache loads: `kubectl scale deploy/modelcache --replicas=1 -n serving`
- rotate logs and compress big logs: `sudo gzip /var/lib/model_cache/modelcache.log && sudo truncate -s 0 /var/lib/model_cache/modelcache.log`
- remove stale snapshots older than 7d from /var/lib/model_cache (after checking checksums)

jen_ops: I'm pushing a hotfix to logrotate and enabling it with a 100MB max file size. Also cleaning up core dumps to free space: `sudo rm /var/lib/model_cache/coredump-*` (will leave one for postmortem).

eng-runtime: Also applying a temporary pod-level ephemeral-storage limit to prevent single pod from filling node: adding `ephemeral-storage: "2Gi"` requests/limits to modelcache daemon for canary.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation started — paging eng-runtime and infra oncall.

pagerduty: page sent to eng-runtime (oncall: leo_runtime).

leo_runtime: Oncall here. Observed that some nodes had syslog flooding from a scheduled debug level on modelcache that spams stack traces every failure. Fixing that reduces log churn.

mike_sre: After truncating logs and cleaning cores, freed ~10-12GB on node, kernel stopped evicting pods. Some pods auto-restarted successfully. Running health checks against affected routes.

ashley_prod: Customer acme reports intermittent successes now, but still occasional 504s. Will monitor.

eng-runtime: We saw one GPU crash trace (snippet):
```
[2029-10-07T03:10:12Z] modelcache: load_shard(14) -> cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2029-10-07T03:10:12Z] runtime error: cudaGetLastError() -> unspecified launch failure
```
I suspect that partial cache restore after eviction leaves GPU with fragmented allocations; restarting pod once disk pressure relieved allowed full restart and normal allocation.

mike_sre: Action timeline so far:
- 03:06 UTC: incident-bot alert (disk pressure)
- 03:08 UTC: cordoned gpuhost-07-ue1, truncated logs
- 03:12 UTC: removed stale snapshots, freed space
- 03:16 UTC: scaled modelcache replicas to 1 across affected pool
- 03:22 UTC: observed decrease in evictions; some services recovered

eve_oncall: Handoff in 20m — I'll take postmortem lead if this stays stable. Also recommend increasing ephemeral-storage eviction thresholds for this pool and reverting the deploy that removed logrotate.

jen_ops: Rolling a config rollback to re-enable logrotate + add restrictive file perms on modelcache logs. Also adding a cron job to prune old snapshots >14 days.

leo_runtime: Long term mitigations suggested:
- Enforce per-pod ephemeral-storage limits and requests for modelcache and any job that writes large artifacts.
- Rework model cache cleanup to stream deletions rather than temp-saving large files.
- Enable early detection alert on /var/lib/model_cache disk usage > 75% per node (currently 90% threshold triggered too late).
- Add startup backoff for cache load to avoid multiple pods simultaneously loading big shards during restart storms.

mike_sre: Customer impact summary to update SEs: Acme & Stellar experienced degraded availability between 03:06-03:20 UTC with partial recovery afterward. Some requests failed with 503/504 and others fell back to smaller models. No data exfiltration.

ashley_prod: I'll draft the customer-facing message: short explanation, actions taken, and ETA for postmortem.

incident-bot: Note: automated incident annotation added to ticket INC-2029-4532.

mike_sre: Leaving follow-up items on the incident ticket: logrotate rollback, ephemeral-storage limits, alert tuning, cleanup cron. Handing off to eve_oncall for postmortem.

eve_oncall: Taking over. I'll run a full RCA and include timeline, contributing factors (logrotate removal, runaway logs, stale snapshots, no per-pod storage limits), and recommended fixes. Will aim to publish within 48 hours. :white_check_mark:

jen_ops: For completeness — saved one modelcache.log copy (22G) to s3://redwood-incidents/1881234567/ for later analysis before truncating.

mike_sre: Closing realtime coordination. Will leave thread open for updates. Great work, team. :thumbsup:
